# Trading-R1: Financial Trading with LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning

arXiv [2509.11420](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.11420) · v1 2025-09-14 · latest 2025-09-14

| Field | Gloss | Quote from the paper |
|---|---|---|
| **task** | Training a financial reasoning LLM that writes structured, evidence-grounded investment theses and outputs five-class trading decisions (Strong Sell to Strong Buy) for equities and ETFs. | “We present Trading-R1, a financially-aware model that incorporates strategic thinking and planning for comprehensive thesis composition, facts-grounded analysis, and volatility-adjusted decision making.” |
| **architecture** | Single LLM trained with a three-stage easy-to-hard curriculum (Structure, Claims, Decision), each stage an SFT warm-start on reverse-reasoning-distilled theses followed by GRPO reinforcement fine-tuning with structure, evidence and volatility-aware decision rewards. | “The curriculum unfolds across three stages, each warm-started with SFT (Figure 3) to establish structural and stylistic priors, and refined with RFT to align behavior through task-specific rewards.” |
| **data** | Tauric-TR1-DB: ~100k samples from 14 large-cap tickers (incl. SPY, QQQ), daily asset-day snapshots of news (Finnhub, Google News), technicals (Yahoo Finance, stockstats), fundamentals (SimFin, SEC), insider/analyst sentiment, FRED macro. | “We construct our dataset from 14 large-cap tickers spanning diverse sectors: BRK.B, JPM, LLY, JNJ, XOM, CVX, AAPL, NVDA, AMZN, META, MSFT, TSLA, QQQ, and SPY. The collection covers January 1, 2024 through May 31, 2025 (roughly 354 trading days).” |
| **window** | Training data covers January 1, 2024 to May 31, 2025; backtest covers June 1 to August 31, 2024, described as a held-out period excluded from training. | “The backtest covers June 1 to August 31, 2024, a held-out period excluded from the training data that reflects diverse market conditions and provides a realistic benchmark for assessing generalization and robustness.” |
| **models** | Qwen3-4B backbone fine-tuned with LoRA; o3-mini/o4-mini used to generate recommendations and GPT-4.1-nano to elaborate reasoning in reverse reasoning distillation. | “We adopt Qwen3-4B as the backbone model, since it is already optimized for reasoning tasks.” |
| **baselines** | Qwen-4B, GPT-4.1-nano, GPT-4.1-mini, GPT-4.1, LLaMA-3.3, LLaMA-Scout, Qwen3-32B, DeepSeek, O3-mini, O4-mini, plus SFT-only and RL-only Trading-R1 ablations. | “For small language models (SLMs), we evaluate Qwen-4B, GPT-4.1-nano, and GPT-4.1-mini. For larger LLMs, we include GPT-4.1, LLaMA-3.3, LLaMA-Scout, and Qwen3-32B. For reinforcement learning–enhanced models (RLMs), we consider DeepSeek, O3-mini, and O4-mini.” |
| **headline_result** | On NVDA, Trading-R1 returned 8.08% cumulative return with Sharpe 2.72 (table; text says 1.88), 70.0% hit rate, 3.80% max drawdown over the Jun–Aug 2024 backtest. | “\| Trading-R1 \| 8.08 \| 2.72 \| 70.0 \| 3.80 \| 5.82 \| 1.80 \| 63.6 \| 3.68 \| 2.38 \| 0.87 \| 60.4 \| 1.90” |

| **leakage_controls** | Trades use only information available up to each trading day; data aligned with strict pre/post ordering; fundamentals filtered to reports published on or before the trading date; test period said to be held out. | “Trades are executed using only information available up to each trading day, eliminating look-ahead bias and ensuring strictly causal evaluation in a fully out-of-sample setting.” |
| **limitations** | Hard-to-predict markets, noisy data, thesis-to-decision gap, reward-induced training instability, persistent hallucinations, and a training universe biased toward large-cap AI-related stocks in a bullish 2024–2025 cycle creating structural long bias. | “Another limitation lies in the training universe, which has been biased toward blue-chip and large-cap companies, especially in AI-related sectors during the bullish 2024–2025 cycle. This introduces a structural long bias.” |
